capabilities.reason: Dispatch SuperClaude-style commands through an isolated subprocess entrypoint.

capabilities.reason: Surface optional SuperClaude MCP recommendations and allow future explicit MCP-backed command execution only after trust.

permissions.reason: Read local repository context and packaged SuperClaude assets.
Write explicit handoff/report artifacts and support implementation-style commands after trust.
Run build/test/git helpers only for commands that explicitly require shell execution.
Perform current research only when web/MCP research is explicitly enabled.
Reserved for confirmed Git operations such as push, reset, or merge; disabled by default in the MVP adapter.
